mapper.select: SELECT t.ID, t.NAME, t.SLUG, t.SEO_TITLE, t.SEO_KEYWORDS, t.SEO_DESCRIPTION, t.SEO_SEARCH, t.ENABLED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, (SELECT u.USERNAME FROM user u WHERE u.ID = t.CREATE_USER) AS CREATE_USERNAME, (SELECT u.USERNAME FROM user u WHERE u.ID = t.UPDATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USERNAME, (SELECT COUNT(ARTICLE_ID) FROM article_tag_relation atr WHERE atr.TAG_ID = t.ID AND atr.DELETED = 0) AS ARTICLE_COUNT FROM tag t WHERE t.ID = #{tagId}
